title: Kalshi Co-Founder & COO on Future of Prediction Markets
description:
Luana Lopes Lara, co-founder and COO of @kalshi_markets, recounts the journey of building the prediction market platform and the challenges of bringing a new financial market category into the mainstream. She explains why prediction markets can offer a unique window into real-time probabilities, assesses the growing appeal among investors and traders and forecasts what the next era of prediction markets could look like.
